## Get started


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, spdep, tmap, tidyverse, knitr, GWmodel, ggstatsplot)
```
:::


## Import data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'

Bounding box:  xmin: 108.7831 ymin: 24.6342 xmax: 114.2544 ymax: 30.12812

```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::


## Join


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan <- left_join(hunan, hunan2012) %>%
  select(NAME_2, ID_3, NAME_3, County, GDPPC, Agri, Service)
```
:::


## Mapping GDPPC


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
basemap <- tm_shape(hunan) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_text("NAME_3", size = 0.5)

gdppc <- qtm(hunan, "GDPPC") +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c("left", "bottom"))

tmap_arrange(basemap, gdppc, asp = 1, ncol = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](inclass-week-4_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=960}
:::
:::


## Preparing data for GWmodel


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sp <- as_Spatial(hunan)
```
:::


## Determine adaptive bandwidth


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_CV <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                data = hunan_sp,
                approach = "CV",
                adaptive = TRUE,
                kernel = "bisquare",
                longlat = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_AIC <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                 data = hunan_sp,
                 approach = "AIC",
                 adaptive = TRUE,
                 kernel = "bisquare",
                 longlat = TRUE)
```

:::


## Geographically weighted summary statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC,
               kernel = "bisquare",
               adaptive = TRUE,
               longlat = TRUE)
```
:::


## Preparing the output data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)
hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan, gwstat_df)
```
:::


## Visualising geographically weighted summary statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "local Mean")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("Distribution of geographically wieghted mean") +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c("left", "bottom"))
```
